name: MiG-29 Fulcrum
author: IornMan1213
description: A flyable MiG-29 (9.12) with its own flight model tuned to real-world data, a cockpit modelled from scratch where every instrument works (20 needles, a rolling attitude ball, HSI, 24-light caution panel, SPO-15 radar warning receiver, gear lights), R-27R / R-27T / R-73 / R-60M missiles, the GSh-30-1 cannon, droppable PTB-1500 / PTB-1150 fuel tanks, flares and radar chaff from its own tail-boom dispensers, a working canopy and gear doors, its own damage display, nine liveries, and rear-view mirrors that really reflect with the NO Mirrors plugin.
